data: Which of the following colors represents the performance metric 'Acc_Softmax'?

The question asks which color represents the performance metric 'Acc_Softmax'. From the caption, we know that the figure is an ablation study of BERT fine-tuning on only the first/embedding layer. The performance metrics shown in the graphs are 'F1_CRF', 'F1_Softmax', 'Acc_CRF', and 'Acc_Softmax'. 

Looking at the graph, the red line represents 'Acc_CRF' and the blue line represents 'F1_Softmax'. The green line represents 'Acc_Softmax' and the black line represents 'F1_CRF'. Therefore, the green line represents the performance metric 'Acc_Softmax'.
